breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between the two specified time integration methods. The incomplete prompt incorrectly listed both 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Strang splitting'. The ground truth correctly removed the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent, however, incorrectly merged the two conflicting instructions, stating to 'Integrate in time with explicit forward Euler using Strang splitting'. This is incorrect as these are two different methods, and the agent repeated the user's error by including both.
